title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Court on Issues Concerning the Priority of Compensation for Construction Project Price

articles.content_en: 1. When hearing real estate dispute cases and handling enforcement cases, the People's Court shall, in accordance with the provisions of Article 286 of the Contract Law of the People's Republic of China, determine that the contractor's priority right of repayment for the construction project prevails over mortgages and other claims.

2. After a consumer has paid all or most of the purchase price for a commercial housing unit, the contractor's priority right of repayment for the construction price enjoyed with respect to such commercial housing unit shall not be asserted against the buyer.

3. The construction project price includes the fees actually incurred that the contractor shall pay for the construction project, such as remuneration for workers and material costs, but does not include losses caused to the contractor due to the employer's breach of contract.

4. The period for the contractor of a construction project to exercise the priority right shall be six months, commencing from the date of completion of the construction project or from the date of completion as agreed in the construction contract.

5. Articles 1 to 3 of this Reply shall come into force as of the date of promulgation, and Article 4 shall come into force six months after the date of promulgation.
This Reply is hereby given.
June 20, 2002
